purpose: Preregistered off-grid physical truth angles for the Phase-III generalization test. Recorded BEFORE any Phase-II optimization was run, and deliberately NOT evaluated with CFD in this task.
selection_reason: Each angle is off the Phase-II integer design grid, absent from T3 training and validation, distinct from the Phase-I 63 deg test angle, and absent from the existing CFD bank, so evaluating them later requires genuinely new mechanistic solves. They span the low, middle and high AoA bands.
delta_alpha_min_note: Unchanged from Phase I so only grid resolution differs. On an integer grid the >= 7.5 deg condition retains exactly the pairs separated by >= 8 deg.

critical_pair_now_resolved.note: The alias that dominated the Phase-I physical landscape is now represented directly on the design grid, which was not the case on the 2.5 deg grid.

evaluation_embargo: No CFD has been run at these angles. They must remain unevaluated until the Phase-III generalization test.

phase1_immutable.note: Phase-I artifacts must not be modified or overwritten.
